授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
自動車，航空機，発電プラント，工作機械，建設機械，ロボットなど，あらゆる機械は制御をおこなうことを前提に設計・製作される．また，高層ビルや大規模橋梁，銀行における決済システムなど，制御工学におけるシステム解析の手法は様々な分野に応用されている．この授業ではこれら工学やシステムの分野において基礎となる自動制御の考え方を講義する．
This class is conducted remotely using Microsoft Teams (online, mainly audio)
and Kyushu University Moodle (WEB on demand).
Thus students are required to register for this course and to register the moodle course.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: System control engineering determines how a system, such as a robotic arm in a mechanical system, should be designed such that it performs the intended task safely, reliably, and efficiently. It provides various perspectives and solutions to these problems. This course aims to provide an understanding of feedback control, which is used in process and servo control, as well as the basics of sequence control, in order to master the fundamental knowledge required for the practical application of system control engineering to mechanical systems.
